question: Individual tensors being full-rank says nothing about 28 of them playing the same role. Do same-role tensors across layers share a basis a shared dictionary could exploit?
verdict: REFUTED for storage, with a mechanism -- and one transferable structural finding

method.pairwise: overlap_r(i,j) = ||V_i^T V_j||_F^2 / r over top-64 right singular subspaces, for all 378 layer pairs per role.
method.null: MEASURED, not assumed: 12 pairs of random orthonormal r-frames of the same shape. Two random r-dim subspaces of R^d overlap at r/d.
method.collective: The number storage would actually exploit. Stack all 28 layers' top-r bases (1792 vectors) and take the rank holding 90% of the stack's energy, against a stack of random frames of identical shape.

why_refuted: The collective measurement decides and it says no. gate_proj's 28 stacked bases span 573 dimensions where random frames span 661 -- sharing buys 88 of 1792, 13% below chance. down_proj buys 16 (1.4%). Break-even for a shared basis of rank R across 28 gate_proj layers is R=1012 of 1024 (1024R basis + 28*3072*R coefficients vs 28*3072*1024), so a 13% concentration is not close to paying for itself.

transferable_finding.claim: Cross-layer subspace alignment is a property of the INPUT SPACE, not of the role. Every organ that reads the RESIDUAL STREAM aligns above chance; every organ that reads a non-residual space sits at chance.
transferable_finding.mechanism: The residual stream is one shared object every layer reads from, so it carries a preferred basis and every reader partially aligns to it. down_proj reads the per-layer MLP intermediate and o_proj reads the head-concatenation space; neither is shared across layers, so neither has a common basis to align to. The split is exact in the data: 1.37-2.12x for all five residual readers, 1.07-1.08x for both non-residual readers.
transferable_finding.status: MEASURED ON ONE SPECIMEN. Stated as a transfer HYPOTHESIS, not a law: it predicts that on any residual-stream architecture the residual readers will align above chance and the writers will not, and it is falsified by a specimen where o_proj/down_proj align as well as q/k/v.
transferable_finding.cheap_to_test: Weights only, no forward pass, 35s on CPU for a 0.6B. Runs on any specimen already on disk.

reopen_condition: Cross-layer sharing reopens if a specimen shows a collective stack rank below ~50% of its random control, or if sharing is sought on the RESIDUAL-READER organs only, where the signal is real (up to 2.12x) even though it is too small to pay at this model's dimensions.
